name: Kikko
description: Kikko, the tortoiseshell: hexagons packed tight, some of them carrying a smaller shell inside.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(100.0% 50.0%, 75.0% 93.3%, 25.0% 93.3%, 0.0% 50.0%, 25.0% 6.7%, 75.0% 6.7%); clip-path: polygon(100.0% 50.0%, 75.0% 93.3%, 25.0% 93.3%, 0.0% 50.0%, 25.0% 6.7%, 75.0% 6.7%); @random(0.45) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(76.0% 50.0%, 63.0% 72.5%, 37.0% 72.5%, 24.0% 50.0%, 37.0% 27.5%, 63.0% 27.5%); clip-path: polygon(76.0% 50.0%, 63.0% 72.5%, 37.0% 72.5%, 24.0% 50.0%, 37.0% 27.5%, 63.0% 27.5%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
